newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Filipinos in S.Korea show Christmas spirit.
newsitem.headline: Filipinos in S.Korea show Christmas spirit.

text.p: A group of Philippine workers in South Korea, most of them staying here illegally, have sent Christmas presents to Korean prisoners in a local jail, a newspaper said on Wednesday.
"We are in a lot of difficulties, but we found out that many Koreans are also in a similar situation," Chosun Ilbo newspaper quoted one of the Filipinos as saying.
"We want to share the joys of Christmas with Korean prisoners spending a lonely holiday."
The gifts included soap, toothpaste and socks.
The paper said the decision by the Filipinos came after one of their colleagues was arrested last September for injuring a Korean during a fight.
Korean inmates helped the imprisoned Filipino, moving the workers to make their seasonal gesture, the newspaper said.
